content: Pɔl kan'lɔm akà Sɛzar
Ungö a ilä itär a ngyeel ande kà itiir a nsi akin, Fɛstüs kàbeenà Yɛlusàlɛm fà Sɛzarɛ.
Amfum a angaŋ anà andweer a Ayudà bayi mufüün Pɔl akà nde.
Ba bàsi muküünà mulɔm naa nde kakyeer ndam a ubwaŋ mubel Pɔl u Yɛlusàlɛm. Kutɛn aŋàbwaŋ ba bàdirà mukun'dwa u mbwo.
Wɛɛ Fɛstüs kàfuur naa bɔlokà a Pɔl là u Sɛzarɛ, anà nde ŋakwo kàkäl u mbwo mufurà.
Nde kàkwɛy naa: « Wɛy baar a an'yeerà uboo a bɛ bàtüüb anà mɛ, ntɔn bi ityà Sɛzarɛ. Kya isàkal naa we anà undiir un'be mbuur awà kàkyer, waa ba bun'füün. »
Fɛstüs kàkäl aŋàsöön ilä naan akɔ̈ɔ̈n kwem apà ba, ungö waa kàtyà Sɛzarɛ. Taaŋtyà, nde kàbwaay u làbay a nsaŋ, waa kàswɛŋ naa bun'twääl Pɔl.
Mpal kàyàkɔlà nde, Ayudà bàfü Yɛlusàlɛm bàkyer un'diŋà, waa bun'füün ndaa a ngwalàngwal mbɔɔn, wɛɛ ba bàsàswaŋ anki naa ya yà ndandaa.
Wɛɛ Pɔl kàsi un'lɔɔn ande, waa kàtɛn naa: « Mɛ akà undiir mwɛy wà ube in'kyer anki, itàkal unsà Un'kɔɔn a Ayudà, itàkal u ndwà a Nzam, itàkal akà Sɛzar. »
Ntɔn mumɛnà mbuur aŋàbwaŋ kusà a Ayudà, Fɛstüs kàfuul Pɔl naa: « Nkye ngye akyàkwen mubeenà Yɛlusàlɛm ntɔn bàtsül ndaa angye u mii amɛ? »
Wɛɛ Pɔl kàfuur naa: « Mɛ in'wà u làbay a nsaŋ a Sɛzar, nsaŋ amɛ bàkàtɛn kwo. Akundiir mwɛy wà ube an'kyer mɛ Ayudà watɛy asànaa ngye ŋakwo ayöb ngye ubwaŋàbwaŋ.

Isàkal naa ndandaa mɛ kàkyer ube mwɛy ban'kwo mutwaal ukwà, mɛ ukwa in'tɔn anki. Wɛɛ, isàkal naa ndaa ban'füünà baar ndɔ̈ŋ aya yatɛy, akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki mukan'pà kà an'kɔɔ aba. Mɛ an'lɔm naa Sɛzar utsül ndaa amɛ. »
Apan, ungö mulwɛɛŋ anà ntɛɛn ande, Fɛstüs kàfuur naa: « Ngye an'lɔm muman Sɛzar, ngye akyer akyà kusà a Sɛzar. »
Pɔl kusà a Angilàpà anà Bɛrnis
Ungö a ilä, mfum Angilàpà anà Bɛrnis bàyi u Sɛzarɛ ntɔn mupà Fɛstüs mbɔr.
Ba paa bàkyer ilä mbɔɔn, lalan Fɛstüs kàkyään nde mfum ndaa a Pɔl mutɛn naa: « We anà baal mwɛy Filikisi kàsàwɛy u bɔlokà.
Umpal kàbeenà mɛ Yɛlusàlɛm, amfum a angaŋ anà andweer a Ayudà bàkyer ayà mukun'füün, ba bàkwen naa bun'dwä ndwà.
Mɛ ba kafuur naa: "Kya kà ifà a baar a Lɔmà anki mupà mbuur kà an'kɔɔ a baar, isàkal naa kusà ande baar bun'füün batɛy, isàkal sye naa nde un'lɔɔn ŋàtàsà anki."
Ba bàyi apà anà mɛ. Mukɔɔn afàsà ilä, taaŋtyà mɛ kàbwaay u làbay a nsaŋ, mɛ kàlɔ̈m naa bun'twääl mbuur awun.
Ayiiŋ ande bàyi ba, ba bàsàmɛɛy anki akà undiir mwɛy wà ngwal uboo indiir ibe kàyweerà mɛ.
Undiir mwɛy bàkäl ba awà anà nde yà mbaaŋ ntɔn inzaam aba ŋakwo, sin sin ntɔn mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Yɛsu, nde kàkyer akwà, wɛɛ Pɔl akakyeyà uyɔl naa nde we anà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Ya yàkäl mpay akà mɛ mutsul ndaa a tub ayi, lalan kàpɛ mɛ Pɔl lwɛŋ mubeenà Yɛlusàlɛm ntɔn bàkàtsul nsaŋ ande kwo.
Wɛɛ Pɔl kàlɔ̈m naa ndaa ande bàkàtsul kusà a Sɛzar. Lalan kàswɛŋ mɛ naa bun'käär u bɔlokà tii mpal in'sun'tɔm mɛ akà Sɛzar. »
Waa Angilipà kàtɛn a Fɛstüs naa: « Mɛ ŋakwo sye in'kwen muwem mbuur awà. » Fɛstüs kun'fuur naa: « Ngye ayun'wem nkàswo. »
Taaŋtyà, Angilipà anà Bɛrnis bàyi unsà làso lanswà, waa bàbilà u làbay a nsaŋ mbwo mwɛy anà amfum a nsaab anà abyääl a bul. Fɛstüs kàswɛŋ naa bun'twääl Pɔl.

Fɛstüs kàtɛn naa: « Mfum Angilipà, anà bɛ banswà làbà pà anà bi, bɛ làkyun'manà mbuur wà. Un'kàbɔ a Ayudà kàyun'füün akà mɛ, itàkal u Yɛlusàlɛm, itàkal apà, bàmusà in'kwɛŋ naa nde ufàkwo anki mukal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Wɛɛ akà mɛ, mɛ in'sàman anki undiir un'be kàkyer nde ntɔn nde ukyà an'lɔŋ. Wɛɛ nde ŋakwo kàlɔ̈m naa nde ukyà akà Sɛzar, mɛ kàtsül naa mɛ in'kyer un'tööm awà.
Itàkal abwɛy, mɛ in'manà anki undiir in'söön mɛ Sɛzar, lalan, an'kwen mɛ naa nde usi un'lɔɔn u mii a bɛ, sin sin u mii a ngye Mfum Angilipà, ntɔn mɛ in'wɛl undiir asɔn ungö a nköŋ ayi.
Ntɔn akà mɛ, ya ikamɛnà naa kà yubwaŋ anki naa mɛ in'töm mbuur a bɔlokà ukɔɔn aswaŋ ubwaŋàbwaŋ ube kàkyer nde. »
